DESCRIPTION: The runner and sleeping first builder were killed after five seconds; restarting on the same store resumed R-1 to passed. Both launches recorded the same session identity, and progress contained exactly one each of stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate.
NAME: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it

DESCRIPTION: The always-red builder logged exactly three launches and the run failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted. The model was called only to render, and no file-verdicts effect appeared.
NAME: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded

DESCRIPTION: A separate HTTP server occupied the configured port. Three seam-answered-before-boot refusals were followed by three gate-refusal effects, the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure, and the candidate launch marker was absent.
NAME: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle

DESCRIPTION: The self-check exited 1 after printing golden checklist differs. Progress reported a failed cycle at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, and self-check was the last effect, with no fence or regenerate.
NAME: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it

DESCRIPTION: The gate command exited 1 with seam-answered-before-boot. Three gate refusals were each followed by a recorded gate-refusal effect, and the run failed at gate for infrastructure.
NAME: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle

DESCRIPTION: Two fixture items received booked/pass and no receipt/fail; Measurement filed 1 of 2 and the run passed. Grain showed judge scores 1.0 and 0.0 under their item names in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the cycle tick.
NAME: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes

DESCRIPTION: With one attempt and a red suite, the gate recorded gate-attempt-failed for suite-red; the launch marker was absent and progress failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.
NAME: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted

DESCRIPTION: The first builder received exactly INSTRUCTION-7. After its red suite, the repair instruction consisted of that text followed by one closing paragraph naming the previous candidate and gate evidence paths as read-only.
NAME: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph

DESCRIPTION: After a green stdio suite and probe, the store check exited 1 with the specified FAIL line. The gate recorded identity-probe-failed and carried that line as detail.
NAME: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail

DESCRIPTION: The stdio suite recorded its environment and exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red. Its environment contained neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store-check marker appeared.
NAME: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store

DESCRIPTION: After the scored fixture run passed, two consecutive run-progress queries returned identical results and both reported passed.
NAME: Reading a run's progress changes nothing

DESCRIPTION: The builder exited 0 without writing a candidate. Progress showed no regenerate effect, recorded fail-cycle, and a failed regenerate stage for candidate-not-regenerated.
NAME: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate

DESCRIPTION: After R-1 passed for C-1, starting R-2 for C-1 was refused cycle-already-run. A progress query for R-2 returned null.
NAME: A cycle is run once

DESCRIPTION: The model stub rejected every researcher request; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts and fail-score-stage was recorded. The run failed at score for score-stage-failed, with no later builder effect.
NAME: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle

DESCRIPTION: The first researcher returned E-ONE; its judge request contained E-ONE. Neither the second researcher request nor its judge request contained E-ONE; the latter held only the second item’s evidence.
NAME: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence

DESCRIPTION: The successful self-check printed the full legacy SKIP line. Its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed the entire text after SKIP as the skipped check, and the effect detail retained the line.
NAME: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP

DESCRIPTION: The green stdio suite, probe and store check yielded gate-attempt-passed with 30 seconds, one poll, answered on poll 1 and answered as the context. There were no gate-refusal effects, and the run passed with its cycle.
NAME: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate

DESCRIPTION: A cut whose spec contained no scenarios recorded stamp and pin, then Measurement refused derive-checklist with empty-checklist. Progress halted at checklist before the cycle and showed no self-check or fence.
NAME: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal

DESCRIPTION: Configuration named builder-clojure, absent from the supplied images directory. Start refused builder-image-missing and run-progress returned null; no builder was configured or launched.
NAME: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused

DESCRIPTION: A delayed writer changed the builder-room suite to exit 1 after the builder ended; its marker and changed file were observed. The installed copy retained the regenerate digest and passed the HTTP gate.
NAME: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate

DESCRIPTION: Both fresh and repair builder launches received exactly three arguments, the third the configured builder-clojure image path. Both effect details named the image and the independently computed image digest.
NAME: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest

DESCRIPTION: The HTTP fixture returned 503 for its first three requests, then served the marker. Gate passed with a 10-second, 20-poll budget and answered on poll 5; the attempt reported a margin of 15 polls.
NAME: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll

DESCRIPTION: The probe accepted exactly one argument, the configured HTTP URL, and required its marker. The gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the scored run passed.
NAME: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker

DESCRIPTION: The cut held impl but not harness/cycles and fenced both. Fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by a recorded fail-cycle; progress failed at fence for fence-refused, with no builder configured or launched.
NAME: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence

DESCRIPTION: Two scored runs on one store used distinct cut IDs and the same selection. R-2 passed with an empty stamp event list, and Measurement’s C-2 scoreboard named C-1 as previous-cycle-id.
NAME: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first

DESCRIPTION: With an approved list containing x and a different fixture rubric digest, the run halted at grader for refused-before-the-cycle, naming the computed sha256 digest. It recorded no self-check or fence and no builder was configured or launched.
NAME: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle

DESCRIPTION: The gate command ran once in the project repository with the cut tree, candidate copy and initially empty evidence directory; the candidate digest matched install and its launch marker was absent. The recorded pass carried 10 seconds, 20 polls, poll 3 and ledger answered as itself.
NAME: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed

DESCRIPTION: The gate command exited 2 with infrastructure the world did not come up. Progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run with that detail, and showed no gate or fail-cycle result and no cycle.
NAME: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate

DESCRIPTION: Three passing runs differed only by no gate command, gate-a and gate-b. The no-command self-check digest matched SHA-256 of the configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order; all three runs recorded distinct harness digests.
NAME: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in

DESCRIPTION: The red-then-green fixture logged two builder sessions with distinct identities. Its ordered start/end log showed the first ended before the second began.
NAME: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it

DESCRIPTION: The stdio suite exited 0 only when plan/01-slice/spec.feature was visible from its working directory. Gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the install digest equaled the regenerated digest.
NAME: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room

DESCRIPTION: While R-1’s builder slept, starting R-2 was refused run-in-progress; progress returned null for R-2 and running for R-1.
NAME: A second run is refused while the first is running

DESCRIPTION: With a green stdio suite and probe and no store-check command, progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run, reporting the missing command. It recorded no gate effect.
NAME: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate

DESCRIPTION: A candidate copy under a fresh /tmp directory with no .pi ancestor ran the HTTP marker fixture. Its gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the scored run passed with its cycle.
NAME: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle

DESCRIPTION: The cut linked plan/01-a to ../spec/a with two stamped scenarios. Stamp recorded both, checklist named 01-001 and 01-002 under plan/01-a, and the run did not halt; it later failed the fixture self-check.
NAME: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target

DESCRIPTION: The builder saw plan and configuration, an absent candidate scope, one commit and no fenced path in the tree or reachable objects. Its provided-runtime entry retained mode 160000 and exactly the cut gitlink object ID.
NAME: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path

DESCRIPTION: The green stdio suite was followed by a probe that printed no response within the 30s boot budget and exited 1. The gate recorded identity-probe-failed with that detail, and the store-check marker was absent.
NAME: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked

DESCRIPTION: Attempt 1 recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair room contained the gate’s proof file with mode 444. Attempt 2 recorded gate-attempt-passed.
NAME: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence

DESCRIPTION: The fixture contained slices 01 and 02 with PLAN_SLICES=02. The only stamp event was 02-001 and the derived checklist contained 02-001 alone.
NAME: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted

DESCRIPTION: The builder wrote a candidate and exited 1. Regenerate recorded its candidate digest, the command gate passed that digest, and the scored run passed with its cycle.
NAME: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated

DESCRIPTION: The judge returned level 2 and feedback without reasoning for 01-002. Grain and progress showed only the 01-001 score; file-verdicts contained only that item and Measurement filed 1 of 2 with 01-002 unreached.
NAME: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached

DESCRIPTION: A fresh retry with a red first candidate and green second passed at attempt 2. Grain showed install, self-check and gate for each attempt in distinct gate-attempt.v1 child ticks of the cycle; repair attempt 2 lay in the first child tick.
NAME: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"

DESCRIPTION: The builder started a 30-second sleep under a 2-second regenerate budget; after the deadline its completion marker did not appear and progress failed regenerate for budget.
NAME: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget

DESCRIPTION: A green HTTP candidate served other instead of the configured marker. Its sole gate attempt recorded gate-attempt-failed for identity-probe-failed, with page lacks marker detail.
NAME: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity

DESCRIPTION: The same researcher code branched on get-input :item and failed for 01-002. File-verdicts contained 01-001 alone, Measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing, and the run passed with its cycle.
NAME: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached

DESCRIPTION: The green HTTP fixture served the marker and the run passed. Progress recorded the eleven effects in the specified order, including gate-attempt-passed and both scoring effects.
NAME: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score

DESCRIPTION: Two fresh stores each filed 1 of 2 with 01-002 unreached and produced exactly two tagged Allure result files. Both runs gave 01-001 passed/booked and 01-002 failed/unreached, with matching historyId and testCaseId across stores.
NAME: The run projects filed verdicts and unreached items into tagged Allure results

DESCRIPTION: The zero-exit self-check printed SKIP bb-tools. Its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools in skipped-checks, and the effect detail carried the printed line.
NAME: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip

DESCRIPTION: After R-1 of C-1 failed at fence, starting R-1 of C-2 was refused run-already-started. The all-runs progress query listed R-1 once, with cycle C-1.
NAME: A run identity is started once

DESCRIPTION: R-1 failed at the fence self-check and R-2 halted on an empty checklist. Five seconds later, both progress results were identical to their earlier readings, including all effects and statuses.
NAME: A run that ended stays as it ended

DESCRIPTION: The repair recorded verification-repair and named the failed gate evidence root. Its room contained clean files, previous candidate and evidence; attempts to create a file in each of the latter two directories were denied.
NAME: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only

DESCRIPTION: The model stub returned HTTP 400 to both render requests. Progress halted at render with effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate or fail-cycle effect and no cycle; no builder was configured or launched.
NAME: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder

DESCRIPTION: The builder left an executable test.sh but no start.sh, with one gate attempt allowed. The gate recorded gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.
NAME: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract

DESCRIPTION: A cut with one stamped and one unstamped scenario recorded two stamp events, then halted at stamp with refused-before-the-cycle and mismatched identities. Progress showed no pin or checklist effect.
NAME: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle

DESCRIPTION: During the sleeping builder, progress reported R-1 running with its tick ID. Its completed nodes included fence then render and its last node was regenerate marked running.
NAME: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed

DESCRIPTION: The first researcher request contained the scenario plus the cut seam and event-model sentinels. Its shell returned Linux and the grading-room files including impl and plan; ls .. exposed only grade-01-001, with no builder, gate evidence, store or sibling room.
NAME: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only

DESCRIPTION: The HTTP marker run passed with eleven recorded effects. The Grain-based event-store check accepted all eleven effect-recorded events inside their named leaves of the cycle or delegated tick, with completed successful workflows.
NAME: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect

DESCRIPTION: Started R-1 against an empty Git repository with the nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run refused not-a-commit and run-progress returned null. No builder was configured or launched.
NAME: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused

DESCRIPTION: The stdio probe recorded the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30 as its two arguments. Its GATE_STORE was in the evidence directory outside the gate room, no LOYLY_ variable reached it, and the store-check argument matched that file.
NAME: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store

DESCRIPTION: The HTTP suite created and removed impl/temp-check before succeeding. The gate passed, and the install digest equaled the regenerate digest.
NAME: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate

DESCRIPTION: Two stdio runs on the same store differed only in store-check command arguments one and two. Both first self-checks passed and recorded different harness digests.
NAME: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command

DESCRIPTION: The cut probe sourced harness/config.sh relative to its own path and required the configured marker at its URL. The gate passed and the install digest matched the regenerate digest.
NAME: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
